---

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

In just three sentences, Republicans are taking aim at people looking to grow their families. **They’re not content with their extreme anti-choice six week abortion ban – which is before most people even know they’re pregnant. Now they’re coming for IVF and for people looking to grow their families.**

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: California or Florida?
body:
Over the past three years, we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu5b08gkl0c5amo73eftkfm9rnhkltdrjd1er830_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctg66pb2c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tlgmmqj6tb76jh3asthejh7bdbkcmoe1cjjedpmedbnmth39ohmmhqrfclmc9jrfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33cllmkrrcpj666ob6o37m2qmash5u)
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zldefgobvdcod6d6ll5i5g4hsi97lf59rqpmdnlg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctg66pb2c1h2bs)
---
Friend, Over the past three years, **we have been called to make choices and answer questions we did not expect.**

Questions about how, in a world that seemed frightening and different, we were going to raise our kids, continue to put food on the table, and care for our communities?

And questions that feel further out now like, how does our government interact with its citizenry in a time of crisis?

How is our government — one of the people, by the people, for the people — meant to protect life, but not stifle liberty?

_In crisis, do we foster freedom? Or do we force our citizens down?_

Well, over the past three years I believe we have had the truth revealed about those two vastly different approaches. Not in an academic textbook or in a theoretical debate, but in the harsh reality of governing during COVID. You could not find two more starkly different examples than the free state of Florida and the woke tyranny of Gavin Newsom’s California.

It isn't hard to understand why the Governor of California wants to talk about Florida. It's part of the one topic he tries to focus on: _**Anything but California.**_

Let's take a look at the record of the “liberal elite” in California:
1. They locked their kids out of public schools at the behest of the teachers’ unions.
2. They forced small businesses to close with many never to re-open again.
3. They hobbled law enforcement and allowed drugs and crime to destroy their cities.

Everything on that list is a tragedy, and it’s only made worse by the disregard and disrespect shown by leaders like Gavin Newsom. The idea of locking down your citizens and then darting off to the fanciest restaurant in the state to rub their noses in it.

It's wrong, it’s disgusting, and it's no surprise that every day driving around Florida I see more and more California license plates as a result.

**In Florida, we didn't bludgeon our people with government mandates; we lifted people up — protecting their jobs, their businesses, and their kids’ education.**
**[Help us keep Florida free in November>>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4uf3k37sbumrir5ai9nh397ugjlf8ph45tg8cm8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctg66pb2c1h2bs "Help us keep Florida free in November")**
We didn't lock business owners out of their livelihoods and we didn't lock people out of their jobs.

**In Florida we didn't turn a blind eye to crime and drugs, we put criminals behind bars, and we kept our streets safe.**

Gavin Newsom doesn't want to talk about California, and I don't blame him. But the reality is, there are plenty of woke liberal billionaires on Gavin Newsom’s speed dial who do not want to see individual freedom succeed. **_They don't want to see it succeed in Florida or anywhere else._**

Because if it succeeds, it shows everyone that the top down nanny-state tyranny of California is avoidable — Free people making their own decisions are better off than a locked down citizenry dictated to by elitists.

That's why I need your help. Gavin Newsom, funded by Hollywood liberals, Big Tech billionaires, and who knows who else is running ads in Florida. _**I need your help to fight back.**_ **On our side are free people who care to stay that way. On their side is everyone who thinks they know better.**

**Show them that we intend to stay free: [Make a donation right now](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcd1cu1dhpopie0r6e4anpou9k2jm8gnjf5h90jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctg66pb2c1h2bs "Make a donation right now") to help us fight back. You can use this** **[secure link](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg9vuq79a2fnj3q8jad5d7r8ek7o947ef1aucg80_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctg66pb2c1h2bs "secure link")**.

Sincerely,__

Friends —
I have about 15 minutes to spare in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: re-election.
And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but after last month it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is now the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States.
And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion.
I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Which is why I have to ask:
[**Can you please split $5 to our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand’s before our mid-month deadline? The amount you give isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Hello,

Revisionists of America's history would have you believe that our
nation was founded on secular grounds and that "a great wall of
separation between Church and State" has been our guiding
principle since the beginning. They would have you believe that
our founders wanted Christianity to be completely absent from all
forms and institutions of government.

That
simply isn't true, and I can prove it. In my brand-new
coffee-table style book, America Is a Christian Nation, you can
see how our country has moved from its reliance on God to its
rejection of God. It's a short read, and we've paired the written
content with some gorgeous patriotic photos that you're going to
enjoy looking through.

TRUTH

I would
love for you to read through America Is a Christian Nation so
that you can understand how our country has moved from its
reliance on God to its rejection of God. It's a short read, and

photos that you're going to enjoy looking through.

Victory today, we'd like to send you a copy of this book along

And thanks to our $500,000 Gospel Advance matching challenge, any
donation you make will be doubled to help Pathway to Victory
reach twice as many listeners and viewers across the country.
That means that twice as many people will hear one of the most
controversial things I've ever said: that America was founded as
a Christian nation!

You only

incredible matching gift opportunity, so make sure you visit this
link today:
https://ptv.org/donate/july-2022-america-is-a-christian-nation-by-dr-robert-jeffress

IMPACT

You may
already be convinced that America was founded as a Christian
nation and that we have strayed far from that foundation. The
question in that case is, how do we get back? You'll find the
answer to that question as well at the end of America Is a
Christian Nation.

As
believers, we need to do all we can to both preserve America's
unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope
you'll stand with me in doing so, and make double the impact at
the same time.

Sincerely,
Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior

| Friend
First Responders sacrifice so much for our nation. They are no strangers to late nights, hard work, and long hours. I should know, I married one!
My husband, Matt, has been a firefighter for years now, and I've seen the amount of hard work it takes. However, Matt wakes up every morning ready to do all he can for our community and neighbors, and I could not be more proud of him for it.
Matt's work is just a fraction of all the work our first responders do, and today, I want your help to thank all of our firefighters, EMTs, and police officers for all they do.

Wade_ , and I am outraged.**

This ruling makes women second-class citizens in our country, withholding the right to make our own decisions about our lives and our bodies.

**I know firsthand what it’s like to make difficult choices and limited options.**

While in the Army and serving as a company commander in Korea, I went to the medical unit, thinking I had a stomach flu. Pregnancy never even crossed my mind - but the doctor conducted a test anyway. It was positive.

**But I wasn’t the first person the doctor told. The doctor had already informed my commanding officer that I was no longer combat-ready. I was stripped of command, and my pregnancy was public knowledge. I was advised to resign.**

Overall, I was lucky. I had a partner, who is now my husband Kevin, and I knew would be there for me. We decided to begin a family. Kevin and I made the best of our limited options. We married, and I resigned my commission.

I didn’t speak of the events again because of the shame involved. From the moment I decided to become a mother, my children’s lives became more important than my own. I know that this choice is life-changing and takes total commitment.

**Peter, everyone should be able to make the decision if, when, and how to become a parent.** I’m infuriated that right now, in states all across this country, including Wisconsin, pregnant women _don’t have a choice._

Patients who want to seek abortion care but can’t afford it, must travel out of our state. Some patients facing medical complications don’t have time to wait. The Supreme Court’s decision is already having unbearable consequences. **Choice is a fundamental right and this decision is a breakdown in our democracy.**

In every election from now on, the right to legal, accessible reproductive care is on the ballot. I will do everything in my power to restore abortion rights at the federal level, so women in Wisconsin and in _every_ state are assured of their most basic rights.

We need a candidate here in our district that is a strong, non-wavering conservative and has proven that they have the work ethic, energy, dedication, backing, and spirit that it is going to take to unseat an incumbent socialist on November 8th! I am that candidate! I have been that candidate for months, dedicating my time to building a winning campaign, and I will continue to be that candidate through every election and when I get to Washington! To get me to the November 8th election, I need your help in the coming weeks! name: Mark Kelly
subject: Trump in Arizona
body:
Derek,
In less than a week, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona and we expect his hand-picked candidate will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.
That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.
Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.
That’s why I need to know if you can split a $25 contribution between my campaign and CommonGood before Trump arrives. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220713_CGVA_Kelly]
Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to start looking at this race. And after that, those same folks are going to start pouring money into Arizona to try to beat me.
So, I’m humbly asking:
Can you please split a $25 contribution between our campaign and CommonGood to help us defend this seat? It all adds up when everyone is chipping in. That’s how we win. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220713_CGVA_Kelly]

Mark

body:
| Peter, we’ve called out Greg Abbot before for using our district and the lives of Texans across the state for photo-ops and election stunts, rather than supporting policies that actually make a difference. Over the last month we’ve seen him continue his pattern of failing and harming Texans and our vulnerable communities over and over again. [**Add your name: Tell Greg Abbott to do better →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47774982/355589849/634869938?source=direct_link&referrer=group-john-lira-for-tx23&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2QwMWI1OS1jNDAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dZZzdPcE2MNthnh34Hf1EmFQHLCCMdGbRzz7SiyUcSk=&emci=4817ef52-c402-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=b7d01b59-c402-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212) After the horrifying and heartbreaking shooting right here in our district at Robb Elementary, Greg Abbott told the press “it could have been worse” to downplay just how devastating it was. And when Texans directed calls for common-sense gun reform toward Abbott, he chose to put his agenda and his relationship with the gun lobby over the lives of our kids and families. Hi friends — **WOW!**

I cannot believe it has been one year since this campaign launched.

It has been an amazing journey so far. We have grown so much, and all this would not have been possible without _you_ , our incredible supporters, who have joined our movement and believe in our vision for WI-01.

**We are building a better future for our district – this is just the beginning.**

I want to take a moment to reflect on the year we've spent together on the campaign trail. Last year when I decided to run for office, it was because I was worried. **Our democracy is under attack, climate change poses an existential threat to our entire planet, and it's getting harder and harder for our working families to get by.**

Let me make this clear: at the age of fifty-five, I am not running for the blood sport of politics. I am running because I am _appalled_ at our current representation. We need representatives who support small businesses, not work on behalf of companies who are shipping jobs overseas.

**We need representatives who serve the people in their communities.**

Bryan Steil could care less. His priorities are to his corporate donors, even at the expense of our district. He's shown us, through his words, actions, and votes, that he won't fight for Wisconsin families, schools, businesses, or for a better tomorrow.

**Bryan has been grossly negligent of our needs at BEST, and this November, we will be showing him the door.**

Our newly drawn maps have made WI-01 one of the most competitive congressional seats this election cycle. And now, with the primary just **one month away** , I am the only Democrat on the ballot. **We have the spotlight, the momentum, the support, and everything it takes to win this.**

When we launched a year ago, I had no idea how far we would come. Still, I was optimistic because I knew one thing was true: **I'm running because the people of Wisconsin deserve better.** Everyone in our district deserves a future where they can afford to look after their families, pay their bills, send their kids to good schools, get quality affordable healthcare, make decisions for their bodies, and chase their dreams.

I am running for _you_ — because it's you that has gotten me this far. So for that, I say thank you.

subject: Madison Horn for U.S. Senate - Volunteer Event Update

We still need people to volunteer at the Porter Peach Festival July 14-16, 2022. The shifts are 2 hours and will consist of sitting at the Tulsa Democratic Party booth distributing literature.

body:
While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. | |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63442%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=B4BgIJ20NGgqWyklEDD4Ew&sysid=1)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---

Fellow American,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** Three short weeks ago, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. **She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.**

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’ve been trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

**[I'm asking 35 conservatives reading this right now to make a gift to my campaign before midnight. | Diehl/Allen Volunteers:
The push to get a referendum on this November's ballot regarding the recently passed law to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants needs your help. Geoff Diehl called for this referendum, because he knows how important it is to let your voices be heard on this issue.
We need to gather 60,000 signatures by August 17th. Please assist!

WHAT: Lead the signature gathering at one of the locations below:
a. Getting signature sheets for ballot petition from Annette Benenato, Diehl Field director(contact: annette@geoffdiehl.com), OR Wendy Wakeman and the MassGOP: wendywakeman@yahoo.com.
b. Be on site for other volunteers to meet you.
c. Collect all sheets from the volunteers at the conclusion of the shifts, and send them to: Amanda Orlando, 1 Western Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930 WHO: Please let Annette know that you are willing to lead your local group at one of the locations below, by emailing her at: annette@geoffdiehl.com.
We will publicize to the rest of the volunteers that there will be collecting efforts, and ask them to join you.

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr13v7pn79su8vbb5tr25683tbc9sp89u2ikceb8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uiq79o5i6crb4spledq75chmecr62pr66phb9odi65i32tjle4pb3cjmm6r73dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmaqrac3imdj3applm3jr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5ctjmcpj1c5i649fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z00aiis6pp4qi4advlq44j2jbtkmrs8hqnhf0vpo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj6cob1chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb3o6adshcqbf69s98ledaj53njkibnnbk79pv10_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj6cob1chh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. Peter, Ronald Regan said it best:
---
**_“You can go to live in France, but you cannot become a Frenchman. You can go to live in Germany or Turkey or Japan, but you cannot become a German, a Turk, or a Japanese. But anyone, from any corner of the Earth, can come to live in America and become an American.”_**
---
I was one of the fortunate ones who truly got to become an American.

My family escaped a kill list in Communist Vietnam and came to America to enjoy opportunity like we’d never known before.

disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Tanya for Arizona
body:
Exciting news from the campaign trail today! Former Trump National Security Advisor Robert O’Brien announced his endorsement of Tanya in the AZ-04 | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/08f425e2da02/team-tanya-alert-former-senator-jon-kyl-endorses-tanya-wheeless-7242121?e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| | |
---
| | | Hi Friend, Exciting news from the campaign trail today! Former Trump National Security Advisor Robert O’Brien announced his endorsement of Tanya in the AZ-04 congressional race.

_“As President Trump’s National Security Advisor, I know firsthand the many real and grave threats facing America. Now, more than ever, we need strong leaders who are willing to stand up to America’s enemies. With her track record of being a problem solver and never backing down from a fight, I trust that Tanya will keep us safe from threats at home and abroad. Tanya is running to protect the American Dream and I know she won’t allow Democrats, China or anyone else to stand in her way. She has already been to the border twice since announcing her candidacy to hear from those on the front lines in order to get to real solutions, showing she is more than just talk,”_ **said Former National Security Advisor Robert O’Brien**

“Tanya is the type of leader we need in Washington to take action and push past political games for real solutions. Tanya will be tough on China, strong on border security and a fighter who will help keep our country safe. That’s why I am proud to endorse Tanya Contreras Wheeless in Arizona’s 4th Congressional District.”
[**Join Former Ambassador Robert O’Brien in Supporting Tanya by Liking and Sharing his Endorsement.**](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=6f1290f3da&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| [ ](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=51281e5d91&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| Ambassador Robert O’Brien joins Tanya Contreras Wheeless’ growing list of endorsements, including the Tempe Officers Association, the National Border Patrol Council, the Phoenix Law Enforcement Association, the Congressional Leadership Fund, Chair Elise Stefanik, Winning for Women, Senator Martha McSally, Senator Jon Kyl, Young Guns’ “On the Radar” list, VIEWPAC and Maggie’s List.

Best,
Team Tanya
---
| \--
More about Tanya:

**_Tanya Contreras Wheeless_** launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. She is a proven leader with a track record of bringing people together to solve problems. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate.

A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She went on to graduate from ASU Law with distinction, earning a job at one of the nation’s top law firms.

Now, Tanya is ready to bring her experience and thoughtful leadership to Congress. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first.

Tanya lives in Tempe with her husband Steve, an attorney and former F-16 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. They have three wonderful children and two dogs who keep them on their toes.
---

This is a public health crisis we cannot accept as a normal part of life. In Tennessee, an average of 1,193 people are shot and killed with a gun every year. Firearms remain the second-leading cause of death for children and teens in the state. Black people in TN are more than eight times more likely to die from gun homicide than white people.

**It’s obvious that we need gun reform to keep our communities safe, but Republicans have consistently stood in the way.** [**_The GOP uses their power to make guns more and more accessible because they are in the pocket of the gun lobby when they SHOULD be working for the people of TN. The Supreme Court decision to strike down common-sense gun regulations is a slap in the face to everyone who has lost someone to senseless gun violence. This is a public health crisis we cannot accept as a normal part of life. In Tennessee, an average of 1,193 people are shot and killed with a gun every year. Firearms remain the second-leading cause of death for children and teens in the state. Black people in TN are more than eight times more likely to die from gun homicide than white people. It’s obvious that we need gun reform to keep our communities safe, but Republicans have consistently stood in the way. We’re tired of justifying our need for safety while our legislature bends to the will of the gun lobby. Let’s create a Tennessee that puts our people first. Dear Peter,

**The Primary Election for Secretary of the State is Tuesday, August 9th!**

If you will be away on August 9th, I encourage you to take an active role in our democratic process by voting by absentee ballot. The process is easy, safe and secure.

**Two ways to vote absentee...**

**One — In Person Absentee Voting**
Starting July 19th you may go directly to your local town clerk’s office to vote absentee in person, easily and securely in a matter of minutes. You will fill out the ballot application in the clerk’s office and then be given a ballot in return. When voting is completed, your ballot goes into a double envelope and stored securely until Primary Election Day when it will be counted. Or your ballot may be dropped into the drop box outside your town hall.

**Two — Absentee Voting by Mail**
1\. [Print out the absentee ballot application here](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=e753e45fce&e=cd99aa018d). Complete the application and return it to your town clerk either via USPS, the drop box outside your town hall or in person. Absentee ballots will be available starting July 19th, though you may submit your ballot application at any point.

2\. The Town Clerk will send you an absentee ballot via USPS.

**3\. Vote for Terrie Wood on line 2C (or 3C in the 4th Congressional District).**

4. Return your ballot (in the double envelope) to the clerk prior to August 9th by mailing via USPS or you may drop your ballot in the drop box outside your town hall.

We need elected officials who empower and inspire. Absentee voting is your privilege and right if you are not if you are unable to vote in person during the primary election.

Make sure you make a plan to vote. The turnout in primaries is typically low - **your vote matters and your voice will be heard!**

Voting is a core principle fo my family and me — [watch my latest video](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=6c5984ebb6&e=cd99aa018d) for more. I will always stand up for your right, as an American citizen, to cast your ballot.

Should you need help in finding your town clerk, polling location, or you need assistance with printing an application, [please let me know](mailto:terriewood@gmail.com?subject=Need%20help%20with%20voting...). | | Derek, When I graduated law school, a lot of my friends ended up on Wall Street or K Street. But I decided to work as a public defender on Bridge Street in White River Junction, Vermont. I loved the work I was doing in the community—and my friends in New York and DC weren’t able to step right outside their homes and onto a trail for running, hiking, or mountain biking. I ran for Congress to serve more Vermonters than I was as public defender, and to keep the beautiful state I loved pristine. Now I’m running for Senate to have an even greater impact for Vermonters. But I decided to work as a public defender on Bridge Street in White River Junction, Vermont. I loved the work I was doing in the community—and my friends in New York and DC weren’t able to step right outside their homes and onto a trail for running, hiking, or mountain biking. I ran for Congress to serve more Vermonters than I was as public defender, and to keep the beautiful state I loved pristine. Now I’m running for Senate to have an even greater impact for Vermonters. But with Mitch McConnell targeting this race, it’s going to take everything we’ve got to keep this seat — and the Senate — blue. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be automatically split between Peter Welch and Mark Warner: = = = = = = Bridge Street is where I got my introduction to how Vermonters get things done: by focusing on solutions, not who gets the credit. I’ve carried those lessons with me throughout my career, and they’ve been a major key to my success as a Congressman. There’s so much we can accomplish for the people of Vermont and for working families nationwide: quality and affordable child care, paid family leave, climate action, Medicare for All, lower prescription drug costs, protecting the right to abortion, strengthening voting rights, and so much more. I’ll continue to work to deliver results on your behalf. But if Mitch McConnell and the Senate Republicans regain the majority, they will continue their assault on individual rights and our democracy. This is the only open seat held by a Democrat this cycle, so we have to win to stop that from happening. = Thanks so much, = Peter Welch Candidate for U.S. Senate, Vermont = * | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

| \---------Forwarded Message------- From: Sheriff Joe Lombardo Date: Wed, July 6, 2022 at 11:55 AM Subject: Let's get down to work.

| Peter,
We might have come out on top in the primary. We might be one step closer to restoring Law and Order to our state, and Keeping Nevada Safe from single-party rule.
But here's the thing, Peter, our work is just getting started.
I didn't enter this race just to come out on top in a Primary Election (although we did have to overcome a multi-million dollar effort from Sisolak's D.C. buddies in order to do so)...
I launched this run for Governor to continue doing what I have for the past 30+ years now - that's protecting our Nevada communities and our way of life.
Because simply put, we can't count on Steve Sisolak to get that job done.
He was more focused on expanding his emergency powers than helping struggling Nevada school children. He listens to Gavin Newsom instead of our state's small business owners. And he stands with criminals instead of law enforcement.
When I take his job in Carson City, I'm going to fix that. Just like I proudly stood for our rights and safety as Sheriff, I'm going to do the same as your next Governor.
Because I know that's our only choice - this election is going to decide the future of Nevada for decades to come... And with everything at stake, we can't afford to give anything less than our best effort if we want to get the law enforcement leadership we deserve!
That's where I need the support of folks like you.
You helped power our campaign through the primary - but now, we need to double down on our efforts with the General Election nearly 4 months out.
I hope you'll please keep up the fight... Team,

You remember **Shaquana Boykin** , right? One of our all-star endorsed candidates, the baddie Assembly District 67 leader from Brooklyn who was up for re-election?

**Well, we’re beyond thrilled to share that Shaquana Boykin just WON her election!**

[](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=7c8c380368&e=007b353608) **Here’s a little refresher about Shaquana:** A product of NYC public schools and the foster care system, she entered the foster system as a teenager — something nobody should have to go through, but it’s shaped who she is today and has driven her long term career of fighting to improve the lives of those in her community and ensuring that nobody is left behind.

**As Shaquana puts it herself:**_“I was once labeled as a disadvantaged youth, those words stuck with me, those words hurt. Everyday since then, I have worked towards never hearing those words said to me or any other child ever again. I have dedicated my life to volunteering in non-profit organizations, helping the youth engage in civic matters, and fighting for the best interests in my community.”_

**Keeping Shaquana’s seat safe was no easy feat.** This was a highly competitive race, and Shaquana was up against some tough corporate-funded challengers. With very little resources to run again, she turned to Barrier to Entry for assistance.

**But all thanks to your incredible grassroots action and generosity,** we were able to provide Shaquana with critical funding and support to help her run a strong people-powered campaign. And take her all the way to the finish line with a win!

**This isn’t just a victory for Shaquana.** It’s a victory for everyone in her district who can continue to count on her to be their voice. And it’s a victory for B/E having another election win on the books, which means it’s also a victory for _YOU_ — **_because our work electing working-class progressive leaders like Shaquana wouldn’t be possible without you.

| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z09kj3gdooumfjj2k3q8kt9nuc2504tjf4gofdi0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zooa9n9e3hufvc56gbiqbsug3aqdlqsuilduc4g8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvejgqapkrmq420qkv2itdal4ekf0suoa1ge8vo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0dg6vk1k6srkptr6s5c8d22l7bq9u4qaqfvvp7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqc2mtrs29gfcj0f90g3ed5mpt96o7s0skko8upg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmmrp7usur0gq0uqgqmnphdsti8kp5l5fr9b7ho0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctj61o72c3h2bs "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**

Marco Rubio

body:
The money wasn't in the budget, but I gave the green light.
#

Hey team, it's Ana. Alessandra's campaign manager.
I had to make a very difficult decision during our team budget meeting yesterday afternoon.
It's become clear that in order to keep reaching out to voters across NY-17 and build our coalition of supporters, we need to drastically scale up our investments in digital advertising and organizing.
See, when people hear Alessandra's story, they overwhelmingly support her and our campaign for Congress.
The problem is that reaching the number of voters needed in order to win takes a lot of resources. And with just 41 days to go until Election Day, we're running out of time to lock in these spending decisions for the home stretch of the campaign.
**The money wasn't in our July budget — but I gave the green light anyway.**
Now, I'm not usually the type to spend money we don't have.
But I made a bet that if I asked, our movement of grassroots supporters would understand the stakes of this decision and step up to help us fill the gap. name: Peter Welch
subject: Defending our democracy
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
The right to vote and the peaceful transfer of power are core tenets of our nation’s democracy:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=655%2E61531%2EG4DEiB)
Hello,
The news coming out of yesterday’s January 6th hearing is _devastating_ —which is further proof that this is an All Hands On Deck moment to protect our democracy.
It’s been easy to take democracy for granted in America, but as the January 6th Commission continues to reveal their findings, it’s more clear than ever: **our fragile democracy is at a tipping point, and we must all work to protect it.**
Yesterday, we learned more about how Trump and his inner circle worked with extremist groups in the leadup to January 6th and how they planned to overturn a free and fair election. The evidence is damning. But too many Republicans are _still_ trying to pretend January 6th didn’t happen.
[**Add your name if you agree: We must protect and defend the right to vote and the peaceful transfer of power. Our future depends on us working together to protect and strengthen our democracy.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-democracy?source=em_20220713_p_p_democracy&t=3&akid=655%2E61531%2EG4DEiB)
Yesterday’s hearings revealed that Trump and his advisors considered _seizing state voting machines_. He has created a party that is intent on eroding democracy by restricting voting rights and casting doubt on election results. Trump-aligned statehouses are now making it harder to vote in the midterm elections, gerrymandering congressional districts to further marginalize voters of color, and taking away the independent role of state authorities to certify election results in order to subvert free and fair elections in the future.
**Our country depends on a functioning democracy—we need All Hands On Deck to protect it.**
When we head to the polls in November, democracy will be on the ballot. It’s up to us to come together to ensure it doesn’t lose. [**If you agree that protecting our democracy is one of the most important issues we face in this election, I’d appreciate it if you signed your name alongside other grassroots supporters.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-democracy?source=em_20220713_p_p_democracy&t=4&akid=655%2E61531%2EG4DEiB)
Thanks for fighting alongside me.
Peter

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Events This Weekend!
body:
Hello Team Geels!

This is a reminder for what's coming up this weekend!

Event: Kinfolk Concert Series
Date: Saturday, July 16
Time: 7:00pm-9:00pm
Place: Graham Amphitheater
104 E. Elm St
Graham, NC

Courtney will have a table set up. Stop by and say hi! It doesn't hurt to wear your Courtney Geels shirts! 😊 Bring chairs or bring blankets and enjoy some quality time with local kinfolk. This is an outdoor concert series & there will be vendors at each event. Check out the link below for more information.__
[https://www.visitalamance.com/event/kinfolk-concert-series%3A-south-of-southern-aaron-silver/23714/](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.visitalamance.com/event/kinfolk-concert-series%253A-south-of-southern-aaron-silver/23714/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1658172359982392&usg=AOvVaw0SvDU49UHwwY9hW2LoVT-W)

Event: Durham GOP Fundraiser featuring Courtney Geels
Date: Sunday, July 17
Time: 1:30pm-5:00pm
Place: Devine's Restaurant & Sports Bar
904 W. Main Street
Durham, NC
RSVP: <https://durham.nc.gop/events> _Click on the date_
Please attend and bring potential supporters! This is an opportunity for you in place of hosting a Meet & Greet!

Hope to see you at either or both of these!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

Dear Peter,

**The Primary Election for Secretary of the State is Tuesday, August 9th!**

If you will be away on August 9th, I encourage you to take an active role in our democratic process by voting by absentee ballot. The process is easy, safe and secure.

**Two ways to vote absentee...**

**One — In Person Absentee Voting**
Starting July 19th you may go directly to your local town clerk’s office to vote absentee in person, easily and securely in a matter of minutes. You will fill out the ballot application in the clerk’s office and then be given a ballot in return. When voting is completed, your ballot goes into a double envelope and stored securely until Primary Election Day when it will be counted. Or your ballot may be dropped into the drop box outside your town hall.

**Two — Absentee Voting by Mail**
1\. [Print out the absentee ballot application here.](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=185d313cf4&e=cd99aa018d) Complete the application and return it to your town clerk either via USPS, the drop box outside your town hall or in person. Absentee ballots will be available starting July 19th, though you may submit your ballot application at any point.

2\. The Town Clerk will send you an absentee ballot via USPS.

**3\. Vote for Terrie Wood on line 2C (or 3C in the 4th Congressional District).**

4. Return your ballot (in the double envelope) to the clerk prior to August 9th by mailing via USPS or you may drop your ballot in the drop box outside your town hall.

We need elected officials who empower and inspire. Absentee voting is your privilege and right if you are not if you are unable to vote in person during the primary election.

Make sure you make a plan to vote. The turnout in primaries is typically low - **your vote matters and your voice will be heard!**

Voting is a core principle fo my family and me — [watch my latest video](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=07e74bcdd7&e=cd99aa018d) for more. I will always stand up for your right, as an American citizen, to cast your ballot.

Should you need help in finding your town clerk, polling location, or you need assistance with printing an application, [please let me know](mailto:terriewood@gmail.com?subject=Need%20help%20with%20voting...). I will make sure someone from my team can assist you or for more information about voting in Connecticut [go here](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=f5cd454291&e=cd99aa018d).

There's something so special about our country - and in order to preserve our freedoms, we must vote.

Warmest regards,
Terrie

_PS - If you will be in town on August 9th and have the ability to volunteer for a few hours - please let me know. Any help you can give is valuable and will help our team greatly._

## Energy - solar sums don't make sense

The media never misses the opportunity to warn us of impending climate disaster. Every hurricane or snowstorm is reported as evidence of the urgent need to switch to renewable energy. Solar, in particular, is presented as the answer. But is it? Since 1979, the federal government has spent over $100 billion dollars on various solar initiatives. Here in Mississippi alone, the Mississippi Public Service Commission has approved $531 million dollars worth of solar panels since April 2021. Most recently they gave the go-ahead for the 100-megawatt solar farm in Sunflower County, which will produce enough energy to power 16,000 homes, we’re told. To be fair to the solar lobby, there have been big improvements in solar technology. In the 1960s, the average solar panel was only capable of converting 5 to 6 percent of sunlight energy into electricity. Today, the average solar panel can convert 15 to 20 percent of the sun’s energy into electricity. As solar panel performance has gone up, the cost of producing them has come down. Still, the sums for a switch to solar do not add up – and nowhere is the gap between the solar promise and reality more glaring than right here in Mississippi. For all the millions of dollars invested in solar power in Mississippi, right now solar only produces a fraction of our total energy needs. Only a little over 2 percent of Mississippi’s energy is renewable, 97 percent of which comes from nuclear power plants. As it stands, a mere 0.68 percent of Mississippi’s electricity comes from solar energy.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=854748df1f&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
|
---
| Since 97 percent of all the carbon-free power produced in our state comes from nuclear power plants, Mississippi would need to duplicate the productivity of the Grand Gulf Nuclear Station 49 times to transition entirely to renewable energy. “But why not just build more solar farms, like the one in Sunflower County?” I hear you say. In order to replace the electrical output that comes from just one of Mississippi’s nuclear power plants, such as the Grand Gulf Nuclear Station, we would need much more than a couple more solar farms. In fact, we would need 21,000 acres of land dedicated exclusively to solar panels just to generate the power that the Grand Gulf Nuclear station produces. To have enough solar capacity to produce the same output as the roughly 50 nuclear plants that we would need to be emissions-free, we would have to cover something like 1,050,000 acres of Mississippi in solar paneling. Even allowing for the fact that some of this might be placed on rooftops or roads, we would still need to cover a great deal of Mississippi’s 10.4 million acres of farmland in solar paneling to produce enough electricity. The laws of physics mean that the cheapest way to generate electricity today, given the technology we have, is to burn coal, oil, and gas. These so-called fossil fuels are, in a sense, recycled sunlight, captured when the coal beds were formed millions of years ago. As America’s greatest physicist, Richard Feynman, explained, the heat that comes from burning gas or coal is “the light and heat of the sun that went in” in the first place. What this means today is that any initiative that entices or requires Mississippi’s energy producers to generate power from sources other than coal, oil, or gas is going to be more expensive. No amount of federal subsidy can conceal the fact that additional costs will eventually land on the consumer. “Hold on!”, some will say. “Isn’t solar energy actually less expensive than the alternatives?” If you take a superficial glance at the prices paid today, that might be true. It is certainly a point that the solar lobby likes to make. To produce a MWh of electricity using nuclear power costs $69.39, and using coal costs $72.78. The average amount charged to produce the same amount of power from solar? A mere $32.78. But there are a couple of catches. For a start, solar power requires having significant storage capacity (there is no sun at night). Once you factor in solar power from a battery storage source, the per MWh cost rises to almost $120. At the same time, the price that is currently paid for solar is not necessarily a market price. It is more the product of a ‘cost-plus calculation’ of what the producers should pay than it is a market-determined price. Take away the various subsidies, soft loans, and tax credits that the state and federal government gives to solar producers, and solar ceases to look like a low-cost alternative to coal, gas, or nuclear. Right now, Mississippi is one of a handful of states that does not have a ‘Renewable Portfolio Standard’. That is to say, we do not have a formal target that requires energy producers to switch to renewable sources by a set date. This is fortunate, given that a study by the University of Chicago recently found that states with renewable portfolio standards witness skyrocketing electricity prices. “Rates increased by 11% when the share of renewable generation increased by 1.8%, and by 17% when the renewable share increased by 4.2%.” Thanks to the recent Supreme Court ruling on the Environmental Protection Agency vs. West Virginia, it is unlikely the administrative state in Washington is going to be able to foist such targets on us anytime soon. But this does not stop both the federal and state authorities from creating every kind of inducement to switch to renewables. There is a risk that subsidies in the Mississippi energy sector could create future supply problems. Remember how, during the Texas heat wave in 2019, the power supply failed? It was not the stifling temperatures but the electricity problems that caused a meltdown. Subsidies had artificially driven the price of power down. So, firms produced less of it. In 2018, a year before the heatwave hit, 5,000 megawatts of capacity were decommissioned. Then the heatwave hit, and the low, subsidized price of $20 per MWh, which scarcely made it worth producing power, skyrocketed. On the morning of August 13th, 2019, electricity prices went from $20 per MWh to $9,000 per MWh by the afternoon. If Mississippi expands solar production through subsidies and tax breaks, a similar scenario will await us.

**_Michelle Brodsky writes about energy policy at the Mississippi Center for Public Policy._**

With liberty,

Michelle Brodsky

Hello,

Revisionists of America’s history would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular grounds and that “a great wall of separation between Church and State” has been our guiding principle since the beginning. They would have you believe that our founders wanted Christianity to be completely absent from all forms and institutions of government.

That simply isn’t true, and I can prove it. In my brand-new coffee-table style book, _America Is a Christian Nation_ , you can see how our country has moved from its reliance on God to its rejection of God. It’s a short read, and we’ve paired the written content with some gorgeous patriotic photos that you’re going to enjoy looking through.

You may already be convinced that America was founded as a Christian nation and that we have strayed far from that foundation. The question in that case is, how do we get back? You’ll find the answer to that question as well at the end of _America Is a Christian Nation_.

As believers, we need to do all we can to both preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you’ll stand with me in doing so.

Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
I’m not asking for your support just because of the (D) next to my name

Folks, I want to make something clear: I’m not asking for your support just because of the (D) next to my name. I’m running proudly on the values, experiences, and perspective I will bring to Congress. To help provide for my family, I started cleaning houses when I was just 12 years old, worked behind the counter at a bagel shop, pushed carts at a grocery store, and waited tables at restaurant after restaurant. And even today, I’ve never known what it’s like to have just one job. **My experience isn’t unique — but in Washington, it would be.** We need more representatives who understand the struggles that regular people face — and who have a record of doing something about it. As a Colorado legislator, I’ve helped pass laws to protect the right to choose, prevent gun violence, ensure equal pay for equal work, and make health care more affordable. **Nothing matters more to me than the communities of CO-07. This is where I grew up — and I am absolutely determined to fight for the rights and opportunities of Colorado families.** I’m fighting to defend the fundamental freedoms that the GOP is attacking. I’m fighting to level the playing field for regular families and make life more affordable. I’m fighting to make sure our kids grow up to inherit a livable planet and a functioning democracy. **[If that sounds like a worthwhile mission to you, then I’d be honored to have your support — because we’re up against millions in GOP spending and we need all the help we can get to fight back. I’m running proudly on the values, experiences, and perspective I will bring to Congress. To help provide for my family, I started cleaning houses when I was just 12 years old, worked behind the counter at a bagel shop, pushed carts at a grocery store, and waited tables at restaurant after restaurant. And even today, I’ve never known what it’s like to have just one job. My experience isn’t unique — but in Washington, it would be. We need more representatives who understand the struggles that regular people face — and who have a record of doing something about it. As a Colorado legislator, I’ve helped pass laws to protect the right to choose, prevent gun violence, ensure equal pay for equal work, and make health care more affordable. name: Frances Hui
subject: I am from a city owned by a country that I don’t belong to
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60796819:6q9zbjVUN:m:1:3253819041:FF4AFF22A7A4774D3BD7C8B37D3052EF:r)
Peter,

Do you know what it is like to be from a city owned by a country that you don't belong to? I do.

I grew up in Hong Kong, a city that was once free.

I was able to get involved in social movements at the age of 13. I was an international advocate and a student leader for Hong Kong.

Then, the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) imposed a national security law that cracked down on political activism in Hong Kong. Offenders could face penalties up to life in prison.

_Now, I am the first Hong Kong activist to receive political asylum in America_.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Frances Hui--former journalist, director of _We The Hongkongers_ , and speaker with the Dissident Project.

The Dissident Project provides high schools with access to informed, intelligent perspectives from speakers who have lived under current and former socialist states worldwide.

[_**Your support goes directly towards helping us teach students about the horrors of communism. Click here to help sponsor a speaker today >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60796819:6q9zbjVUN:m:1:3253819041:FF4AFF22A7A4774D3BD7C8B37D3052EF:r)

China is the 21st-century version of totalitarianism. They are the ultimate surveillance state. Your every action is evaluated by the government's social credit score.

The CCP's take over of Hong Kong has left no part of our lives untouched. They are turning Hong Kong into China.

_**Now, I am from a city owned by a country that I don 't belong to.**_

The Chinese Communist Party has done its best to silence any news of opposition. The once-thriving civil society in Hong Kong is completely demolished as the government criminalizes and interrogates dissidents and social workers.

They've even convinced corporations and international non-profits to turn a blind eye to their atrocities.

Worse, they sometimes collude with the CCP.

This is why the Dissident Project is so valuable. _This might be the only time high school students get to hear the truth_ about how life in Hong Kong has radically changed since being under the thumb of the CCP.

**I want to share my story with students across America. **

[_**Will you help me reach students with my story? Your gift of $3, $35, or even $100 helps me travel to high schools across the country. Please donate by clicking here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60796819:6q9zbjVUN:m:1:3253819041:FF4AFF22A7A4774D3BD7C8B37D3052EF:r)

**Let me share how the Dissident Project works:**

Dissident Project speakers come from countries across the globe like Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea, and China.

We undergo a rigorous audition and training process. There we learn to communicate our experiences in a _powerful but compassionate_ way.

Topics like this can be tough for students to understand. That's why _we are specially trained to address students and have mastered the art of covering difficult and complex topics for young audiences. _

It costs roughly $1,000 to host a speaking event on a high school campus.

The Dissident Project is a not-for-profit endeavor. We don't charge schools for access to our speakers, so their testimonies are more accessible to all.

**But to keep our services completely free, we rely on the generosity of our donors. Will you chip in today and support the Dissident Project?**

body:
It’s that time of the year where campaigns get increasingly desperate. Here’s why we’re different.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220713-3214-header&t=1&akid=3214%2E2526796%2EMlupES)
Are you on other political email lists?
If so, you probably regularly receive urgent and panicky emails asking for money. Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM machine. They use scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating.
It’s bad, and getting worse. Team AOC is determined to rise above that and treat you and our other grassroots supporters with respect. Here’s what we believe:
\- Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action.
\- Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, we want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content.
\- Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, we’re honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.
\- Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and causes who need it.
**But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have fundraising goals and deadlines.** Everything we raise each quarter is detailed in our public FEC report, and we want to post the biggest possible fundraising numbers. But we’re not going to scare or scam you into donating. We’ll just ask nicely because your donations to AOC are important and meaningful.
[Would you be able to make a $3 donation to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez right now to help us start the new quarter strong? We’d really appreciate it.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220713.bVg-Za&refcode=em20220713-3214-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3214%2E2526796%2EMlupES)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220713.bVg-Za&refcode=em20220713-3214-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3214%2E2526796%2EMlupES)**
If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. We still want you here, and we still appreciate you reading our emails.
The truth is that this email list is powerful. It’s powerful precisely because you’re here, with so many others. It’s powerful because when so many of us take collective action all at once, we can make real change.

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoh4sgoqp9lsfakdaioe6nujer3c4m8rcidmdkho_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq3ec3gcmrb0tjnmdgb1c5mckoeccdncmr79pjk6qpn5cj4sphrcttieeo72pr0sv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666pbbd9nm8q6cd70mdgmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933cljmeob1c9h64oh5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za8pkp5q341ne3d0k4hbdb90a9tspufj3dul0rj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9ubkso4ko6dj19sjrjnijoght2l9g4l6m58a8cg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfgnier7cgo1jl1r4q2rvkvcblr87ivsbb0tpu48_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd6v79699o7iudfqs9r1o7l1r3dt16r20bccmrco_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoooqu0j16k92fguesicckseudra2uelks8mujig_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoiuug5diss4guc3b850st3qsfo72mid0flrfmao_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zduqo5bkuis7lt3k7rvnb6obvj7q6lgrf127asho_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfjoin0m1grtkgnek8euvfd277tba9p07u4hciu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znck5qmgjc539nqnkjuqia0btufkkl83o5601oco_rp22sh2s8i66pb7ctgm2oj2c9h2bs)**

body:
|
---

| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47789707/355645417/-1259897983?amount=25&refcode=20220713_f_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmUwNzRmYi1lYjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9Xg_Z5QqhUWDsls6Nm4tVGSeI-uiTMXvl3a8Nbzyku8=)
---

Hello,

Every day, we hear from Floridians who are concerned about the future of our state and want to know what they can do to help end the failed leadership from Ron DeSantis.

**Well, here's the truth about our campaign:** Our strategy depends on raising grassroots contributions from our supporters, and that's not always easy.

And just hours ago, the House once again passed the Women's Health Protection Act, sending it to the Senate. **Congress MUST keep pushing to protect abortion rights nationwide.**
Now, some bad news.
Every day, women are being denied their own bodily autonomy. Millions have lost the right to make the most intimate decisions about their bodies. **And Republican legislatures are preparing to pass the worst, most dark-ages legislation they can: criminalizing abortion, punishing providers and other who "aid and abet" abortions, and going after contraception.**

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Become a Citizen co-sponsor for my bill to protect the right to contraception
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We are already seeing efforts by state and local governments to take away access to contraception methods, especially after the Supreme Courts extreme decision on abortion.
#
Peter, when it comes to our reproductive freedom, it is clear that the right-wing, extremist Supreme Court will not stop at overturning _Roe v. Wade_. We must fight to codify abortion rights in Congress, and we must also pass legislation to protect the right to contraception.
We are already seeing efforts by state and local governments to take away access to contraception methods, especially after the Supreme Court's extreme decision on abortion. **With the Protecting Access to Contraception Act that I introduced last week, we will guarantee that anyone who wants access to contraceptive care can get it without state or local officials weighing in on their bodies and their reproductive choices.**
[**Peter, will you support my legislation to protect access to contraception? We need to show there’s overwhelming support for contraceptive care in America and ensure we can protect access in the face of an extreme Court. Add your name to my bill right now >>**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/protecting-access-contraception/?source=em20220713-1424&t=1&akid=1424%2E420207%2E1lcPbl)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/protecting-access-contraception/?source=em20220713-1424&t=2&akid=1424%2E420207%2E1lcPbl)**
A radical, extremist Supreme Court is taking away our rights. SCOTUS is stepping in to overturn settled precedent on abortion access, gun safety, environmental protections, and much more. Justice Thomas indicated he’s ready to overturn Court decisions establishing same-sex marriage rights and the right to contraception.
The Protecting Access to Contraception Act would forbid state or local governments from prohibiting or otherwise restricting the possession, sale, purchase, transportation or use of any contraceptive that relates to interstate commerce.
**It’s critically important that we act on this now.** That means codifying abortion rights AND the right to contraception. The House must pass my contraceptive care bill. Then, the Senate must nix the filibuster and pass both bills to protect reproductive rights and care in America.
Are you with me, Peter?
[**Become a citizen co-sponsor of my Protecting Access to Contraception Act now to rally behind legislation to protect our rights. We need to get this done — add your name now.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/protecting-access-contraception/?source=em20220713-1424&t=3&akid=1424%2E420207%2E1lcPbl)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/protecting-access-contraception/?source=em20220713-1424&t=4&akid=1424%2E420207%2E1lcPbl)**
Thank you for taking action today.
In solidarity,
Pramila
