body:
If you’ve been hurt or a family member is a victim of gun violence, you can now go to court and hold the makers of these deadly weapons accountable.

Friends -
It’s well known that nearly every industry is held to account when their products cause harm or injury.
Except one.
The gun industry.
They’ve spent millions of dollars over the years buying up politicians to shield themselves from the pain they cause in our communities.
Yesterday, California changed that.
I signed a bill allowing Californians to sue irresponsible gun manufacturers or distributors.
If you’ve been hurt or a family member is a victim of gun violence, you can now go to court and hold the makers of these deadly weapons accountable.
Our kids, families and communities deserve streets free of gun violence and gun makers are going to be held accountable for their role in this crisis.
We’re taking action in California, and we’re saving lives.
According to the Giffords Law Center, in 2021 California was ranked as the TOP STATE in the nation for gun safety. Our commonsense laws have allowed us to cut our gun death rate in half.
All while other states like Florida and Texas saw double-digit increases.
To the victims of gun violence and their families: California stands with you.
Thank you,
Gavin

subject: I wrote myself a letter in 2014
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont, P
body:
I wrote this as a way to remind myself why I was choosing to run for office | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47790862/355649556/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMWQ2MGI2OS1lZjAyLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZPgxz-Pcif8dJ_OxBqTsslPmXF3Xu-1OtujTVIUCuKE=&emci=d94d46ab-fdd1-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=d1d60b69-ef02-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402272) | Hey Peter, While I was cleaning my house a few months back, I found a letter that I wrote to myself in 2014. At that time, I was preparing to run for State Senate for the very first time. I remember being filled with the worries that come with any new challenge, and I wrote this as a way to remind myself why I was choosing to run for office. I want to take a minute to share it with you: _**_Why am I going to run?_**_ _**To improve people’s lives. To bring jobs, economic prosperity, and hope for the future to my community. To push people to be their best selves.**_ _**To get people more engaged. To make lasting positive change. To change minds, to tweak beliefs about what is possible, to elevate the discussion. To bring more compassion and understanding.**_ _**To change the way we engage with ideas. To push people to look beyond easy answers. To make the political arena safe for nuance. To help us find the overlap. To move away from demonizing each other. To build coalitions.**_ _**To teach about give and take. To fulfill a calling. To use my gifts and talents to serve others. clean_body: I wrote this as a way to remind myself why I was choosing to run for office | | Hey Peter, While I was cleaning my house a few months back, I found a letter that I wrote to myself in 2014. At that time, I was preparing to run for State Senate for the very first time. I remember being filled with the worries that come with any new challenge, and I wrote this as a way to remind myself why I was choosing to run for office. I want to take a minute to share it with you: Why am I going to run? To improve people’s lives. To bring jobs, economic prosperity, and hope for the future to my community. To push people to be their best selves. To get people more engaged. To make lasting positive change. To change minds, to tweak beliefs about what is possible, to elevate the discussion. To bring more compassion and understanding. To change the way we engage with ideas. To push people to look beyond easy answers. To make the political arena safe for nuance. To help us find the overlap. To move away from demonizing each other. To build coalitions. To teach about give and take. To fulfill a calling. To use my gifts and talents to serve others. To enjoy the challenge of a very difficult job. It’s now seven years later, and every word of this letter still rings true. | I hate asking for money.

Maybe it’s my middle class upbringing...

Or the fact that I worked my butt off to get through college and law school...

But asking for donations is definitely my LEAST favorite part of campaigning.

And it shows.

**According to the last reporting at the end of March:**

_Mark Kelly had raised over $38 million for his reelection..._

_Jim Lamon had raised over $13 million (that includes a heart seven-figure loan of his own money to his campaign)..._

_And Blake Masters was at close to $4 million._

_Meanwhile, I’d raised about $2.5MM._

See?

And yet here’s the crazy thing:

Even though I don’t have some fundraising machine like my opponents...

I’m still right in the thick of the GOP Senate Primary.

I guess it’s my track record...

And the fact that I’ve spent the last 7 years vigorously fighting for conservative values in the state of Arizona...

But considering that Masters is the Big Tech protégé of a literal billionaire...

While I’m a public servant...

Neck-and-neck is pretty good.

**Pretty good, but not great.**

This is the final stretch...

There are less than 21 days left until the August 2nd Primary...

And if we’re going to win this thing, and get into position to defeat Mark Kelly this November...

Then I need your help.

**That’s why, even though I hate asking for money...**

I’m going to do it.

$5, $20, $50...

Every [donation](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=590da5072e&e=6dcd2506d1) makes a difference and whatever you’re able to give, I will be grateful for.

Trust me, I wouldn’t be asking if the stakes weren’t so insanely high.

But they are.

**Many people have said that I’ve got the best chance to beat Mark Kelly in a general election...**

But if we don’t get out of the primary, that won’t matter.

That’s why it’s so vital that we finish strong and WIN this primary...

And I need your help to make that happen.

I don’t know about you...

But I know another 6 years of “Senator Kelly” will be a disaster for America...

And if you agree...

[**Go here now and help support the campaign right away**](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=a214365a47&e=6dcd2506d1)**[. ](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=99a77065e7&e=6dcd2506d1) **

Sincerely,

Mark

| | | _We wanted to make sure you saw Mckayla’s message from yesterday.**W****e now have less than one week until primary election day in Maryland – and tomorrow is the end of early voting!** Don’t miss your chance to contribute to a historic win!_ _\- Team Mckayla_
* * *
Team, On Thursday, early voting ends in our primary. After that, we will have to focus on getting our supporters to turn out on Tuesday, the 19th. **_That’s just one week away._** [**_Can you rush a donation now to make sure we have the resources to reach all our voters in this last week of the primary campaign?_** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wibNoIUvZEm1lbrPl8E8BqNKUZ4Gmumaj5nR8E0JKN6xdLTEjMUkEa1ExCxwO2cUuE2wyDnhUN2nPw-tKzpTGtw2DLdg34wTNnjZHA8Zx1ztCO5BqKE29HvDmBPoO_x0HprZbanSfJQ2m6Q6w1hFEwTaMpk3CQ74IMXuXg1dHkVr5AlMg73yIz3ufO-K5W55R7jgf0hEx2htAxtqXpUaxSpyhr5g7HJ9RrSG--gBg-81QlTlaSBGym79vkccPSA0xza-pRuAexUcCkYS-7iBemasJXOjTov3MF4nAi1mBYkQ/3np/B7ojMaSaSAyQ1Qdcp0J32g/h0/E-l72iCeii1N77wEIgnV3M6CAsq0V88mKHwzGEsT4b0) We’re running out of time to send a clear message that voters in our district are fed up of politics as usual. We’re ready for change – ready for _justice_. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek —

In a moment, [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220713_B1_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=958%2E1862389%2EE3cLvO ]I will ask you to donate to our campaign for One Georgia,
but first, I want to tell you a story. It’s a story my grandmother, Wilter
Abrams, told me about the first time she cast a ballot.

The year was 1968, and my grandmother, born and raised in Mississippi, was
eligible to vote in a presidential election for the first time. For so
many Black voters in the South, this chance to cast a ballot was the
culmination of centuries of struggle.

Outfitted in his Sunday best, my grandfather called out for her to finish
getting dressed and head to the precinct. But my grandmother hesitated.

I asked her why she faltered after such a long fight — after braving the
dogs, the hoses and the billy clubs. She told me, "I wasn’t afraid of the
right to vote — I was afraid of the power." She was most afraid that she
would finally be able to exercise this fundamental right — one that she
and so many others fought so hard for — and that nothing would change.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220713_B1_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=958%2E1862389%2EE3cLvO ]Our voices have immense power,
Derek, and we can change our
future together. Will you contribute $5 today to help fund
a campaign determined to create a brighter future for Georgia?

My parents raised me to believe the right to vote is sacred and that you
work for it — and you work to ensure everyone else can too. But our
opponents would rather make it harder for Georgians to participate in our
democratic process than to lose control.

Despite her fears, my grandmother voted that day. She voted because of the
people — including my parents — who had sacrificed their liberty and, for
some, their lives, to secure the possibility. And she never missed an
election. My mission is to protect our right to vote so that our democracy
reflects the needs and ambitions of those it governs.

We have the power to build a better Georgia — for ourselves, for our
parents and grandparents, for our children and their children. But the
current governor is going to put obstacles in our path every step of the
way to stop that from happening.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220713_B1_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=958%2E1862389%2EE3cLvO ]Derek, I am
fighting to make sure we remove the barriers people like my grandmother
and families all across Georgia face. Will you contribute
$5 now to our fight to open the gates of opportunity for
all Georgians?

If we get to work, we can change the future.

Thank you,

Stacey

Outfitted in his Sunday best, my grandfather called out for her to finish getting dressed and head to the precinct. But my grandmother hesitated. I asked her why she faltered after such a long fight — after braving the dogs, the hoses and the billy clubs. She told me, "I wasn’t afraid of the right to vote — I was afraid of the power." She was most afraid that she would finally be able to exercise this fundamental right — one that she and so many others fought so hard for — and that nothing would change. [ ]Our voices have immense power, Derek, and we can change our future together. Will you contribute $5 today to help fund a campaign determined to create a brighter future for Georgia? My parents raised me to believe the right to vote is sacred and that you work for it — and you work to ensure everyone else can too. But our opponents would rather make it harder for Georgians to participate in our democratic process than to lose control. Despite her fears, my grandmother voted that day. She voted because of the people — including my parents — who had sacrificed their liberty and, for some, their lives, to secure the possibility. And she never missed an election. My mission is to protect our right to vote so that our democracy reflects the needs and ambitions of those it governs. We have the power to build a better Georgia — for ourselves, for our parents and grandparents, for our children and their children. But the current governor is going to put obstacles in our path every step of the way to stop that from happening. [ ]Derek, I am fighting to make sure we remove the barriers people like my grandmother and families all across Georgia face. Will you contribute $5 now to our fight to open the gates of opportunity for all Georgians? If we get to work, we can change the future. Thank you, Stacey +---------------------------------+ | PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR | +---------------------------------+ Abrams for Governor 931 Monroe Dr NE Ste A102 #363 Atlanta, GA 30308 United States Contributions to Abrams for Governor are not tax deductible.

Fellow American,

**One of the most important constitutional duties of the federal government is to provide for the common defense of our country.**

The men and women who wear the uniform of the United States of America deserve our tremendous support and encouragement. After all, they put their lives on the line daily to defend our freedoms and way of life.

That's why I was stunned when I learned that **Senator Raphael Warnock said, "you can't serve both God and the military."**

Not only do I vehemently disagree with Senator Warnock's words, but I also find his record as a senator to be appalling when it comes to our Armed Forces.

_**Since he was sworn into the Senate, Senator Warnock has been complicit with President Biden's disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, voted against billions of dollars in veterans care, and has repeatedly failed to support our troops.**_

That voting record doesn't represent Georgia.

clean_body: I was stunned when I learned that Senator Raphael Warnock said, "you can't serve both God and the military." | Fellow American, One of the most important constitutional duties of the federal government is to provide for the common defense of our country. The men and women who wear the uniform of the United States of America deserve our tremendous support and encouragement. After all, they put their lives on the line daily to defend our freedoms and way of life. That's why I was stunned when I learned that Senator Raphael Warnock said, "you can't serve both God and the military." Not only do I vehemently disagree with Senator Warnock's words, but I also find his record as a senator to be appalling when it comes to our Armed Forces. Since he was sworn into the Senate, Senator Warnock has been complicit with President Biden's disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, voted against billions of dollars in veterans care, and has repeatedly failed to support our troops. That voting record doesn't represent Georgia. I don't just talk about supporting our troops. I have dedicated over a decade of my life to traveling the country meeting with members of our military to share my mental health journey, inspire hope for people who are struggling, and remove stigmas around seeking treatment. I have visited numerous military bases and seen firsthand the tremendous sacrifices that our men and women in uniform make. As a Senator, I will invest heavily in our military to ensure we have the best personnel and equipment, never negotiate with terrorists, and never leave any American behind. I will make sure our troops have the support they need! Georgia voters need to know about Senator Warnock's awful words and dismal voting record. I hope you agree, Fellow American, that our troops deserve our full support. I will stand with them, and I hope you'll stand with me. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. body:

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2b447bd67e5241dcb08fcfed8444efde&_e=Z9KODLN_ITfcKJ1Q3dXuAl7q7bBmcavyjTS7L-ohCfK1EruGbr6B6FpPcVBWBDupa7G82iy8OA87qOR45Je7c_zkp-A1p9BcPyJayW8LpDKnEYdFU1tCoKDy9B1BB-DKSKoGwpfSt4a3YmjIengOQbLgBbGLk_hqUsC6fdcOWgr2b5qkAcwA6x8JJARXyNmQRedMiEa1EbpALNfQBpa1zb_PHHvrQdSMCVMgVfKwLLJwfXdz5ciptqyxp7R_XDY5X8HiM8MJb6JG4BOcMwkcqZaGSEJQbWImy98OVTAE7ta7d2JFYI3AxrNh7JbOOqfuMbe7FDEeAQDFvGkIuOChs-L2LqI62lGS7rbhflWc1PDiKtwCKoMCJbviZXAVpb-XZYO-c7jHC9rVoPm0Ts_sSl8Ckcl6kcqEoWpaVp_4qEzA-QIIEddDydDJ2UsGgzT1sIZu9ic4va9jlzhvcV5iJw%3D%3D)

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” Through “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,” you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life. | | Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group. You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. | | | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. clean_body: It has all been worth it to see the impact that John is already making on this state. | = | Peter, I’ll be the first to admit that this past year of campaigning with my husband John hasn’t always been easy. Now, as we near Primary Election Day in just 6 days, I can say with confidence that all those long drives from Silver Spring to Hagerstown, all those late nights making calls, all those meaningful conversations with Marylanders have all been worth it to see the impact that John is already making on this state. I’ve known my husband for a loooong time (we just celebrated our 21st anniversary!), and I know better than anyone just how good a governor John will be. John’s entire career in public service — whether as a high school social studies teacher, a middle school principal, President Obama’s Secretary of Education, or a leader of a national civil rights organization — has been leading to this moment. His vision to build a more equitable Maryland is grounded in a clear understanding that schools save lives and state government has the power to be a transformative force of good. School saved John’s life when he was a kid, and as governor I know he’ll fight tirelessly to ensure every Maryland child receives the world-class education they deserve. Not just in the areas with wealthy zip codes, but in every corner of the state. But, he needs our help to send him to Annapolis. John’s campaign team has communicated to me how crucial the final push to the primary is, and recent polling shows that over 20% of likely Democratic voters are still undecided. Peter: We knew it wouldn't stop at Roe. In his concurring opinion to overturn Roe v. Wade, **Justice Clarence Thomas laid the groundwork for destroying countless other civil liberties that Americans count on – and marriage equality is at the top of his list.**
LGBTQ activists fought for decades to win the right to marry who they love and live their lives as their true selves. **But now, ultraconservative justices on the Supreme Court are setting the stage to take away LGBTQ rights and turn back the clock on years of progress, despite 70% of Americans supporting same-sex marriage. The only way to defend the right to marry who we love is for Congress to codify marriage equality once and for all.**
In the Senate, Trudy will protect marriage equality and defend LGBTQ rights. **She'll be a bold leader who will stand up to bigotry and defend civil liberties like marriage equality. **

Meanwhile, instead of serving Minnesotans and Americans who are struggling due to her bad policy, she is getting rich off campaign cash and cozying up in a recently finished mansion.

Friend, I’m asking you for $3.

Here’s why: Polls show me neck and neck with Marco Rubio – and, according to _The Miami Times_ , I’m rapidly closing the gap.
I know $3 doesn't sound like much, but that's how we've built the momentum to make our race competitive. When thousands of people like you join our team with even $3, we build a powerful and unstoppable movement.
But the GOP dark-money machine is determined to destroy our momentum and defeat me at any cost, so I’m leaning on this grassroots team again to help flip Florida blue.
**I've set a goal to raise another $20,000 before MIDNIGHT, but we’re still $2,592 short. And, at this point in the election, when Rubio and the GOP are launching another round of vicious, nasty attack ads to defeat me, missing this goal is not an option.**
In the time that it’s taken you to get to this point in the email, seven people have already donated $3 to join our team, but I’m counting on you to chip in too, friend.

subject: There’s nothing I like more…
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071322 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071322] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
There’s nothing I like more than campaign season. Hitting the road, meeting voters, hearing their concerns and learning what worries Michiganders all across the state. I know Jocelyn feels the same.
It’s a busy time and it’s an important time, this year more than ever. That’s because election conspiracies are spreading like wildfire. By talking with voters in person, we can make sure they know the truth about our election process.
secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071322 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071322]Over the past few months I’ve continued to gain enthusiasm and hope for our democracy. Dear Peter,
In case you missed it, I just wanted to make sure that you saw the last email from my Finance Director, Tom Brennan. I’ve had the privilege of working with Tom for many years now, and there is perhaps no one I trust more when it comes to the critical work of managing our team’s finances.
When Tom says we need to pick up the pace on fundraising, he means it – so I’m once again asking you to help us reach our $15,000 grassroots fundraising goal by July 15.
Anything you can spare in these final days will make all the difference. The earlier your donation, the greater your impact. Click here to chip in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0713?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
Thank you,

body:
| It’s official: Dan is now running in the “median” congressional district in America. What does that mean, exactly?

It means that Michigan’s Eighth Congressional District is at the center of America’s politics. Exactly half of the country’s districts are more Democratic, and half are more Republican. It’s a true toss-up seat. And with 435 congressional seats, it sits exactly in the middle—the 218th seat—that will determine control of Congress.

In mid-Michigan, people rightfully don’t think about politics every day. Working families are worried about putting food on the table, paying rent and raising their families. They reject partisan politics and don’t care which party you’re affiliated with—they just want their elected officials to work on issues to make their lives better.

That’s the leadership that Dan Kildee brings to Congress. He’s focused every day on lowering the cost of gas, groceries and prescription drugs. He’s worked with Republicans and Democrats to protect the Great Lakes and support fair trade deals that boost Michigan’s manufacturing.

But as the Cook Political Report just put it, **_“Kildee could be in for the race of his life.”_** That’s because this new, middle-of-the-road district is a true toss-up, and could go either way.

Peter,
I want to make it known where I stand when it comes to protecting the citizens of Colorado in a post- Roe v. Wade America. Before I get into the details, can you chip in $25 today to help me continue fighting for democracy? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2207-q3-jg-tweet?refcode=220713-email&amount=25]
Last week, I joined Governor Polis in making it clear Colorado will not extradite anyone for a criminal violation of another state’s laws related to abortion services.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2207-q3-jg-tweet?refcode=220713-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2207-q3-jg-tweet?refcode=220713-email]
Extradition paperwork must include the state seal, and the Secretary of State has the legal authority to apply the seal. Colorado will not allow anyone to be extradited for seeking abortions or reproductive health care, and I will not apply this seal to any paperwork that would harm a person seeking care.
Coloradans have continued to elect officials who trust women to make our own decisions about our bodies. Because voters have had access to the polls, leaders who share the beliefs of the majority have been elected to office. Issues like reproductive rights remind us just how important voting and participating in democracy is. That is why I’m proud of the work I’ve done to make Colorado the gold standard when it comes to how elections should be run, and I’m hoping to keep it up.
Help me protect the right to choice and our fundamental freedoms by continuing to protect Colorado elections. Chip in to my re-election campaign today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2207-q3-jg-tweet?refcode=220713-email]

Basic things we took for granted before Tim Walz and Joe Biden took office like available power, affordable groceries, ability to drive our cars and safe streets are being extremely challenged on a daily basis. | | Dear Peter, OLCV is proud to announce “**[This is How we Win: Climate Organizing 100 Series](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47796788/355676649/1534396290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxNDJmYWFjLTA5MDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P3fd4Bfd16ekRX2SI8DpyvKfTxpfoX3x_yMqTut6qtw=&emci=0e50c89a-0703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6142faac-0903-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** ,” a trio of youth-focused workshops happening from late July through September focused on educating others about the different levels of work that contribute towards a strong, successful environmental movement. Each event is an entry-level course tackling individual components of climate organizing akin to what we do here at OLCV. These courses include: **-Demystifying the Legislative Process 101** : which will break down how Oregon’s legislative sessions function and how we can work with our legislators to pass important climate policy. **This course will take place on Zoom on Wednesday, July 27th from 5:30 - 6:45pm,** and will reflect on how successful climate legislation has been passed previously, in addition to forecasting what’s at stake on the ballot this November. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47796789/355676650/1534396290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxNDJmYWFjLTA5MDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P3fd4Bfd16ekRX2SI8DpyvKfTxpfoX3x_yMqTut6qtw=&emci=0e50c89a-0703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6142faac-0903-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) **-Winning Elections 101** : a comprehensive examination of the organizing power that drives successful campaigns and what you can do to get involved in supporting meaningful electoral initiatives. **This training will take place on Zoom on Wednesday, August 31st from 5:30 - 6:45pm. ** **-Canvassing 101** : a guide for how we can take the organizing lessons from the other two courses and practice them to successfully advocate for the election of OLCV-endorsed climate champion, Tina Kotek, in her race to be Oregon’s next governor. **This in-person event will take place in Portland on Wednesday, September 28th from 5:30 - 8:00pm; exact location TBD.** The first two trainings will be held online, and the final training, Canvassing 101, will take place in-person at a location in Portland yet to be determined (virtual option available). We strongly encourage everyone to attend these events to learn more about what goes into environmental organizing– _especially youth who care about our planet and are interested in getting involved with climate activism._ [**Sign up for OLCV's "This is How We Win: Climate Organizing 100 Series" using this link.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47796790/355676651/1534396290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxNDJmYWFjLTA5MDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P3fd4Bfd16ekRX2SI8DpyvKfTxpfoX3x_yMqTut6qtw=&emci=0e50c89a-0703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6142faac-0903-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) But that’s not all! Other events that should be on your radar are **screenings of the film “ELEMENTAL”,** directed by Trip Jennings and narrated by David Oyelowo. The powerful documentary redefines the relationship between wildfires and human life, pushing us to reconsider the role of these natural blazes in our ecosystems and teaching us what we can do to stay truly resilient against them in hopes of inspiring forward-thinking wildfire policy. The film premieres in Portland on July 20th, but will be expanding its theatrical run to cinemas around Oregon and along the west coast, with more screenings in different cities yet to be announced.** [Find a showing near you!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47796791/355676652/1475644262?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxNDJmYWFjLTA5MDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P3fd4Bfd16ekRX2SI8DpyvKfTxpfoX3x_yMqTut6qtw=&emci=0e50c89a-0703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6142faac-0903-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** We urge you to attend at least one of these amazing events, if not all of them. No matter what, it’s important to stay aware of all the different ways we can remain engaged in the fight for our climate. Thanks for your support, we hope to see you there! Thank you, Britney VanCitters, Organizing Manager, OLCV

| | | Dear Peter, **Early voting ends TOMORROW (Thursday) @ 8PM!!**

Are you going to be out of town on vacation next week? Do you have any friends or family members who will be? Or maybe you have an all-day work conference next Tuesday.

Election Day is next Tuesday, July 19th. And though I know everyone is excited to get out there and vote - sometimes life gets in the way. That’s why early voting is so important. _You have two more days_ (Today and Thursday) to Early Vote if you’re not able to cast a ballot in-person on Tuesday, July 19.

I need your help to spread the word!
* **Vote today! **If you haven’t voted yet - you can vote for me in-person today or tomorrow. [Click this link to find a list of locations by county.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=ea2e22b348&e=0faa9de128)
* **Tell 10 friends today!** Your personal endorsement is priceless, and the information about early voting might be even more so. If you know anyone who is going out of town or busy next week - make sure they go to the polls today or tomorrow! This race may well depend on them!

And, as always, if you are able to help my campaign with a donation - we need all the support you can give. **We’re in the crucial last week of this primary election and every dollar donated will get spent reaching more voters.**
[Click here to donate if you can.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=812223e88f&e=0faa9de128)

Have a question about voting? Just respond to this email and we'll try to help!

Thank you for everything you do for this campaign.

Sincerely,
Ben

And it's not working. At least twice this week, Webster's operatives were booed and shamed at various campaign events by the crowd of voters.

**Voters aren 't dumb, and they deserve respect!** They deserve a candidate who will put in the work for them. And that's my intent!

[Help me get to Washington to work for you!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/LxBkFuoQ763D8UaA763892q23fNw/MmSo0PQJ9Ma9xWw47y7a7Q)

clean_body: They can’t shut all of us up. Will you join me in helping to elect working champions at every level of government who will fight for abortion rights by making a contribution to the Working Families Party? | | | Peter, Last week, in the dead of the night, Republican lawmakers in Pennsylvania snuck an anti-abortion constitutional amendment through its first phase of legislative approval. And when they brought it to the House floor for a vote, and I took the podium to push back against their claims that it wouldn’t change a thing about abortion laws in our state — they turned off my microphone. I was in the midst of speaking truth to power, informing voters of the ramifications of the proposed constitutional amendment and calling out the hypocrisy underpinning Republicans’ newfound enthusiasm to let voters decide the fate of abortion rights after abetting efforts to overturn the 2020 election, when they decided to try and silence me. For the last 30 years, Republicans have controlled the Pennsylvania state legislature, clinging to power through a timeline of deflections, half-truths, and outright lies. Now they’re trying to clear a path to erode abortion rights in our commonwealth and make it harder for Black and brown communities like mine to vote. With the U.S. Supreme Court’s recent decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , abortion rights now hinge on our governors, state legislatures, and State Supreme Courts. But they can’t shut all of us up. Election after election, WFP has been turning movement energy into real electoral and legislative power — committing its resources to helping progressive candidates win up and down the ballot in communities across our Commonwealth and across the nation. Point-blank, the path to protecting abortion access, keeping and expanding our slim majority in Congress, and building progressive power runs straight through Pennsylvania and other states like ours. But with help from our friends at the Working Families Party, we’re building power from the ground up to win the future we deserve. In solidarity, Malcolm Kenyatta Pennsylvania State Representative Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | | | | | Peter, **You blew past our goals for supporting Cheri Beasley’s campaign this week. THANK YOU! **We’d hoped that 150 of you could support her campaign, and 176 of you chipped in, raising $4,290 for her race to be the next Senator from the great state of North Carolina! But like everyone else, Cheri has been facing the early summer fundraising slump. All the parents know: summer vacation is time off for the kids, and _showtime_ for parents and grandparents. Meanwhile, the National Republican Senatorial Committee has already spent $6 million on ads against Cheri. As you probably know, negative ads often discourage low-information voters from even showing up to the polls, and she’s looking to get 10,000 new donors to support her campaign by this Friday at midnight to help cover the costs of voter outreach and education. **Do you think we could help Cheri find another 50 donors from the Blue Amp community, so we can work towards a better future for all the kids?** [**Could you be among the 50 donors we’re hoping would please give $2, $4, $10 or whatever you can afford to elect former North Carolina Supreme Court Justice and all-around great person, Cheri Beasley, as North Carolina's next Senator?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T827fdffa-1c15-4d61-9194-f03a05196ddd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for your courage and generosity, Cliff On Fri, Jul 8, 2022 at 10:35 PM Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action <info@blueampaction.com> wrote: Peter, Congressman Ted Budd hates women. He is, by all accounts, a woman-hating, right wing scoundrel. Luckily, we have Cheri Beasley, running against this troglodyte. She'll fight to codify Roe and protect all women's right--actually, greatly expand them. She supports the Equal Rights Amendment, equal pay and taking guns away from boyfriends who stalk, harass and commit acts of violence against women.

body:
Hispanics are more than just tacos, despite what you and your husband may think. It shows your ignorance and your disrespect for our community. Jill Biden seems to think that all Hispanic Americans are the same as breakfast tacos. Let me tell you something: we're not. | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=97fff5ae78d84fe996f745f752d439b5&_e=dWD-oOIMTr8xo-ggSTSffoUbL16O-hVOpmNxH86u_0r2L8JVXHpjKG1KrXUKDtC-6cNDUyLoY5YIGp2TDeYtMoTk4LqdrmK97KrIoFtdWH03y6uodwPKXyDODNJVtV4ODWIaZsq6gNoZ6-Wzu_UsMM2wtj1MgjCohR9VASo7cQugPdY3865VKRNKIw7UAM9kZybuBWSTuku0mI8FWYqBw9VrzoqnT5KktKFZXfzivCcra9INr5fdkPL8R1gBx9pCd_3YTKMdg6KoB_BXekpY0NhtvNwlewmICN1g5QM_mar5WxgMiQ-RKpKM327KTIUL37kJvvWFUdSCOQ24QolxWRNqDkmFcsN7LiETMDODR5q0vIHzGtaxtno_hPlZYhRWGhqb_KmZHkQxiDHbdEya51SdR5aKmC-ju5Z1ua99m1l51_ParXhTkr2TgWDJccJTusGg1XbIMapCXs-4qVO-oFRww4J6RmR66Cmpc6GW8eQ%3D)

Peter,

As a Hispanic female running for Congress in Texas, I have a message for First Lady Jill Biden: **We’re more than just “breakfast tacos” as you described us today in a speech you gave in San Antonio.**

We’re Americans, just like you. **We’re not a one size fits all culture like you and your party like to believe**. together.

# [Judicial Watch: NIH Records Reveal FBI Inquiry of Wuhan Grant](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59371&L=27674&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmloLWZiaS1pbnF1aXJ5LW9mLXd1aGFuLWdyYW50Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWNvcnJ1cHRpb24rY2hyb25pY2xlcyZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz)
Judicial Watch announced recently that it received 1651 pages of records from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) revealing an FBI “inquiry” into the NIH’s controversial bat coronavirus grant tied to the Wuhan Institute of Virology. The records also show National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) officials were concerned about “gain-of-function” research in China’s Wuhan Institute of Virology in 2016\. The Fauci agency was also concerned about EcoHealth Alliance’s lack of compliance with reporting rules and use of gain-of-function research in the NIH-funded research involving bat coronaviruses in Wuhan, China.

**First:** It will require hospitals to provide abortion care if the person’s life is at risk, regardless of state law.

**Second:** It will defend access to FDA-approved drugs used to aid abortion, which is important because over half of all abortions in the U.S. are medication-induced abortions.

**Third:** It will take steps to protect a patient’s private information, search histories, and phone applications and help states and medical providers that create opportunities for abortion care for out-of-state patients.

**Fourth:** It will direct the federal government and its agencies to protect access to contraception, including Plan B and IUDs.

This is an undeniable step forward. We will continue to fight for the codification of _Roe v. Wade_ and reverse state abortion bans.

| Recent polling shows the Democrats with a small — one percent — advantage when voters are asked which party they would like to control Congress.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=494%2E5257348%2EsN1zlU)
Derek,
For just a moment, let me take you back to Saturday, November 7, 2020.
After three and a half excruciating days of ballot counting, and endless lies and Twitter diatribes from the twice-impeached president, the Associated Press and the major news outlets declared Joe Biden the winner and president-elect of the United States.
Yet Democrats had fallen short of claiming a majority in the Senate, and our House majority had barely *just barely* survived — losing more than a dozen seats to Kevin McCarthy and the Republicans.
At that moment, we had avoided four more years of Donald Trump, but our prospects of getting anything through a Republican Senate were slim. And McConnell looked like he might be back for two more years as majority leader. We had two runoff elections in Georgia, but we would have to run the table there if we were going to be able to govern.
But Democrats beat the odds and flipped the Senate through Georgia — and it’s exactly what we’ll need to do again if we’re going to keep our House majority, elect more Democrats to the Senate, and break the filibuster that’s prevented so much progress.
Derek, I can’t promise you that it will be easy. In fact, I can tell you with all certainty that we have a tough fight ahead of us. Recent polling shows the Democrats with a small — one percent — advantage when voters are asked which party they would like to control Congress. That’s a lot better than it had been, but it’s still a coin toss.
We will have to fight hard to win, but we can do this. And we know the consequences if we don’t. We’re seeing the consequences of GOP policies on the news every day — the loss of rights and freedoms, the damage to our democratic institutions, a reactionary social agenda, and no reprieve from the scourge of gun violence.
That’s why I have to ask:
**[Will you contribute any amount to my campaign today to help me defend our House Majority with everything I’ve got? We can beat the odds again, but it will require all of us working as one to support Democrats running nationwide.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2022_abs_em.4MLSU6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220713_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=494%2E5257348%2EsN1zlU)**

body:
Growing up, my two siblings and I spent Saturdays helping our parents with “Soup to Go”, which provided meals, supplies, and solidarity to people who’d been disenfranchised and dismissed from society.
**I’m running for Congress because I’m appalled that families go hungry in the richest nation in the world. **
Rep. Jay Obernolte voted NO on boosting the Child Tax Credit, which had lifted millions of families out of poverty until it expired.
**[In Congress, I’ll bring back the Child Tax Credit, because making sure children have enough food to eat is a moral good.
